description: Bâtiments communaux Fernelmont is a dataset listed in Open Data Wallonie Bruxelles, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Commune de Fernelmont. Tous les bâtiments communaux. Coverage: Fernelmont. The portal files it under Administration et Services publics. Its keywords are bâtiment. The portal shows 48 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2021-03-02 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support building stock, energy use and retrofit studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-odwb-be-portal.
